title: Desenvolvedor MES Sênior (Opcenter Execution)
description:
Buscamos profissionais que encaram a complexidade industrial como um tabuleiro de estratégia.

Se você é desenvolver MES em Siemens Opcenter Execution e sabe como transformar processos produtivos em fluxos digitais de alta performance, seu lugar é aqui.

Estamos em busca de um perfil Sênior para atuar em projetos críticos, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e integridade dos dados no coração da manufatura.


O que você fará:

  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Liderar o desenvolvimento de customizações e extensões no Opcenter Execution (Core/Discrete/Medical).
  • Integração de Sistemas: Desenvolver e manter integrações robustas entre o MES, sistemas de automação (PLC/SCADA) e ERP (SAP/Oracle).
  • Otimização de Processos: Modelar fluxos de produção, genealogia de produtos e gestão de ordens dentro da plataforma.
  • Mentoria Técnica: Apoiar o time em desafios técnicos complexos e garantir as melhores práticas de codificação e arquitetura.
  • Solução de Problemas: Atuar na causa raiz de incidentes críticos em ambientes de missão crítica.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Domínio em Opcenter Execution: Experiência sólida com a plataforma Siemens (antigo Camstar ou SIMATIC IT).
  • Stack de Desenvolvimento: Proficiência em .NET (C#) , WCF , Web Services (REST/SOAP) e XML .
  • Banco de Dados: Experiência avançada em SQL Server (Stored Procedures, Performance Tuning e modelagem).
  • Conhecimento Funcional: Entendimento profundo de normas como ISA-95 e processos de manufatura.
  • Inglês: Nível técnico para leitura, documentação e eventuais interações com suporte global.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Mendix (integração Low-code com Opcenter).
  • Conhecimento em SignalR ou protocolos industriais (OPC UA, MQTT ).
  • Certificações oficiais da Siemens.

Detalhes da Contratação:

  • Modelo: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica).
  • Duração: Projeto de longo prazo.

title: Consultor de Investimentos B2B/B2B2C
description:
Empreenda como Consultor Independente com a Revert - B2B/B2B2C


Você buscou ser livre.

Mas a operação te prendeu de novo.

Relatório pra um cliente.

Conciliação de outro.

Extrato que não bate.

E-mail cobrando posição.


No fim, você virou consultor pra passar mais tempo com cliente…

e está passando mais tempo com planilha.


O que é a Revert


A Revert é uma empresa de tecnologia baseada em serviços, criando um ecossistema de consultorias de investimentos independente, construída para tirar o peso da operação do consultor.


Aqui, a lógica é simples:

enquanto você está com o cliente, a operação roda por trás.

  • Consolidação de carteira automática
  • Suporte operacional completo
  • Uso de tecnologia e IA para ganho de escala
  • Atendimento em múltiplas instituições (sem ficar preso a uma plataforma)
  • Acesso a TODOS os bancos.


Não é software.

É o serviço funcionando por você.


Para quem é

Essa oportunidade é para quem:

  • Já tem carteira de clientes no mundo consultoria
  • Quer parar de perder tempo com operacional
  • Busca mais tempo de qualidade com o cliente

title: Data Engineer III
description:
Posição temporária!


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

• Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.

• Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

• Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;
  • Garantir que o time esteja alinhado com evolução da plataforma e todos entendam as motivações por trás delas;
  • Identificar e antecipar impactos das abordagens em outros produtos cross-squads;
  • Trazer a visão do todo, ao colaborar com o planejamento, acompanhamento e organização de uma dada iniciativa que visa onde outro analista, seja responsável, até a entrega de valor, ajudando a mapear os possíveis riscos e impactos;
  • Orientar, engajar e fomentar proativamente a cultura data driven em toda a Empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.

title: Agentic Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

lifecycle. This includes using agents to assist with design, implementation,

testing, debugging, and code quality while maintaining full ownership of

correctness and production readiness.

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain critical systems and services across the client's platform
  • Develop scalable, secure, multi-tenant features and services used by customers and internal teams
  • Build and maintain backend APIs and service-to-service integrations
  • Contribute to modern web applications using Angular or comparable frontend frameworks
  • Improve system reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help modernize legacy components while preserving stability in a live SaaS platform
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering patterns
  • Write and maintain automated tests
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving
  • Mentor engineers and help raise technical standards across the team
  • Participate in incident response and operational improvement as needed
  • AI / Agentic Responsibilities:
  • Use AI agents and LLM-based tools as a core part of daily development workflows
  • Apply agents to support:

Requirements clarification

System design

Code generation and refactoring

Debugging and root cause analysis

Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, service-oriented architecture, or event-driven systems
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Experience using agents to support requirements clarification, solution design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, code review, and test creation
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic
  • Proven hands-on experience using AI agents, orchestration tools, or structured LLM workflows in real development environments
  • Experience using agents to support:

Requirements clarification

Solution design

Code generation

Refactoring

Debugging

Code review

Test creation

  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience working with tools or frameworks such as: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar

custom-built agent workflows

  • Strong understanding of limitations, failure modes, and trade-offs of LLM-based systems


Preferred Experience

  • Experience modernizing or untangling legacy web platforms
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, observability tooling, and operational support in distributed systems
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
  • Experience improving performance, stability, and operational maturity in customer-facing SaaS platforms
  • Experience applying TDD, test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together.
  • Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions.
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment.
  • Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

description:

▪ Proficient with design methods/patterns (e.g., DRY, SOLID, ReST) and their practical application

▪ Proficient in MacOS, Unix, and Linux

▪ High-level understanding of in-memory distributed data storage systems like memcache, ehcache, Hazelcast

▪ Proficient in Git

▪ Experience with continuous integration systems like Jenkins, GitHub, and GitHub actions

▪ Preferred experience with cloud deployments (Preferably Azure)

▪ Experience with build tools like Maven

▪ Experience with using the IntelliJ IDE

▪ Proficient with profiling tools

▪ Able to compare and contrast third party libraries

▪ Excellent English Level (verbal and written) communication skill

▪ Working knowledge of Windows, Unix, and Linux

▪ Highly motivated and driven by a desire to solve difficult problems, and learn new technology

title: Consultor SAP ABAP/CPI
description:
A Softtek está em busca de um(a) Consultor SAP ABAP/PO/CPI Sênior para fazer parte do nosso time e Atuar no AMS com atendimento de incidentes e melhorias de diversos clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento e experiência na tecnologia SAP PI/PO/CPI;
  • Experiência com múltiplos padrões (Cloud-to-Cloud, Cloud-to-On-Premise) e adapters (HTTP, File, RFC, OData, SOAP, IDOC, SFTP, REST).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura, monitoramento, troubleshooting e administração de interfaces em geral;
  • Experiência com Groovy Script para customizações e validações.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de iFlows.
  • Vivência em SAP GRC/DRC (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e).
  • Vivência em segurança em integrações (certificados, OAuth2, Basic Auth, TLS).
  • Necessidade de ter conhecimento sobre o conector SAP Cloud;
  • Conhecimento em Design Iflow e desenvolvimento em SAP CPI;
  • Diferencial ter vivência em cenários com SuccessFactors, Salesforce, Ariba, Concur...;
  • Conhecimentos em BTP: API Management, Event Mesh e Integration Advisor.
  • Conhecimentos consolidado em ABAP: Dicionário de dados(tabelas ,visões, elementos de dados, domínios... ) de relatório (ALV; ALV OO), programas de carga e extração (Batch input, bapi), interfaces.
  • Criação e manutenção de Funções/RFC, Includes;
  • Criação e manutenção Sapscript e Smartforms;
  • Aplicação de notas SAP;
  • Dialog Programs: criação e manutenção de telas para entradas de dados (Online);
  • Enhancements: criação e manutenção de user-exits (Menu, Screen, Function module, etc), extensão de objetos do dicionário de dados;
  • Conhecimento BADIs, regra de subistituição e validação para o módulo de FI.
  • Experiência em ABAP proxy (SPROXY/SOAMANAGER);

title: Tech Lead Software Engineering  - TypeScript (Remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa inovadora do segmento de georastreamento e rastreamento inteligente , que utiliza tecnologia para gerar insights estratégicos através de dados de localização em tempo real.

Buscamos um(a) Engineering Tech Lead com perfil hands-on , que combine excelência técnica com capacidade de liderança, atuando diretamente no desenvolvimento e na evolução de um produto altamente escalável e orientado a dados.


Sobre a posição:


Essa posição tem um equilíbrio entre desenvolvimento (50%) e liderança (50%) , sendo ideal para alguém que gosta de codar, tomar decisões técnicas e desenvolver pessoas ao mesmo tempo .

Você liderará um time ágil multidisciplinar, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade enquanto contribui ativamente com o código e a arquitetura das soluções.

A posição é 100% remota e o modelo de contrato é CLT. Inglês é essencial, pois a comunicação será com times internacionais .


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações escaláveis utilizando Node.js e TypeScript
  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura de sistemas (microserviços e integrações)
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e deploy
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas técnicos complexos
  • Assegurar performance, confiabilidade e segurança das aplicações
  • Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver engenheiros
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (Scrum)
  • Gerenciar backlog, priorização e definição de histórias
  • Garantir entregas dentro do prazo e com qualidade
  • Balancear evolução do produto com gestão de dívida técnica


O que esperamos desse profissional:


  • Perfil hands-on , com forte atuação em código
  • Capacidade de liderar pelo exemplo
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis e de alta velocidade
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio
  • Visão de produto aliada à execução técnica
  • Forte experiência com Node.js e TypeScript
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços
  • Vivência com AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, etc.)
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com Scrum/Agile
  • Sólida base em system design e escalabilidade
  • Experiência prévia liderando ou mentorando times


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em frontend moderno (React, Angular)
  • Experiência com Ruby on Rails
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, etc.)
  • Experiência em ambientes de alto crescimento (startups/scale-ups)


Experiência:


  • +6 anos em engenharia de software
  • +2 anos em liderança técnica ou gestão de times
  • Experiência com APIs, cloud e sistemas distribuídos


Se você gosta de atuar de forma hands-on, liderar times e construir soluções escaláveis em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a dados, essa pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você.

Candidate-se e venha fazer parte dessa jornada!

title: SAP FICO TRM Consultant
description:
We are currently looking for an SAP FI Treasury Consultant to join a project with a client of ours in Brazil.


Start: ASAP

Duration: 12-month initial contract

Location: Remote

Languages: English speaking and Portuguese speaking

Type: Contract/Freelance

Role/Responsibilities

  • Configure and support SAP FI modules with a focus on Treasury and Risk Management (TRM).
  • Ensure compliance with local and international tax regulations within SAP FI.
  • Collaborate with finance and treasury teams to gather and analyze business requirements
  • Design and implement automated treasury solutions using Alteryx, SAP FI, and Power BI.
  • Map treasury processes and identify areas for improvement in automation and efficiency.
  • Support audits and tax filings through accurate reporting and documentation.
  • Provide training and support to finance and treasury teams on SAP FI functionalities.

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit

title: Senior Software Developer (.NET)
description:
Se você gosta de construir aplicações robustas, manja de boas práticas, curte trabalhar com arquitetura limpa e quer evoluir em um time que valoriza engenharia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo, essa oportunidade é pra você!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core Apis;

- Micro-serviços;

- SQL Server;

- xUnit (Testes unitários);

- Git;

- RabbitMQ;

- Metodologia ágil (Scrum).


Diferenciais:

- Kafka;

- Docker;

- CI/CD.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend - Especialista
description:
O seu papel como Especialista em Engenharia de Software Backend será:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Liderança no desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Atuar como referência técnica dentro do time, atuando como mentor de pares de menor senioridade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.

title: Freelancer | AEM Content Author (Adobe Experience Manager)
description:
Buscamos um(a) AEM Content Author responsável pela publicação de conteúdos digitais no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), garantindo consistência, qualidade e alinhamento com as diretrizes de marca e estratégia digital da empresa.

Esse profissional atuará em conjunto com times de marketing, UX/UI e tecnologia, sendo responsável por assegurar que os conteúdos sejam entregues com excelência, seguindo boas práticas de usabilidade, SEO e governança, além de contribuir para a evolução contínua da operação digital.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Criar, editar e publicar páginas, componentes e conteúdos no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM);
  • Gerenciar a estrutura de navegação, organização de páginas, taxonomia e metadados;
  • Garantir a correta aplicação de SEO on-page, acessibilidade e boas práticas de conteúdo;
  • Revisar conteúdos assegurando consistência visual, textual e aderência às diretrizes de marca;
  • Validar o comportamento das páginas em diferentes dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Apoiar campanhas digitais, lançamentos de produtos e atualizações de conteúdo recorrentes;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de marketing, design, produto e tecnologia;
  • Realizar testes básicos antes da publicação (links, imagens, componentes, navegação);
  • Identificar e reportar inconsistências ou bugs, colaborando com times técnicos na resolução;
  • Apoiar a validação de novos componentes e funcionalidades dentro do AEM;
  • Contribuir para a organização e melhoria contínua dos processos de publicação e governança de conteúdo.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) como Content Author;
  • Conhecimento em estrutura de páginas, templates e componentes no AEM;
  • Noções de HTML e CSS para entendimento de estrutura e ajustes básicos;
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de SEO e acessibilidade;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de design como Figma e Adobe Photoshop;
  • Perfil organizado, com atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar com times multidisciplinares.


DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência com ferramentas do ecossistema Adobe, como Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Launch, Adobe Assets;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise como Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM);
  • Conhecimento em personalização de conteúdo e segmentação de audiência;
  • Experiência com CMS headless ou arquiteturas híbridas;
  • Experiência com CMS Wordpress, Drupal, Joomla ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de apoio à criação de conteúdo baseadas em AI, como ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly ou assistentes de escrita e otimização de conteúdo;
  • Noções de uso de AI para geração, revisão e otimização de conteúdo (SEO, copy, variações);
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

title: Consultor (a) SAP SuccessFactors EC PL/SR
description:
Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

  • Advise: Acompanhamos os nossos clientes na transformação da sua função de RH, através de uma redefinição da sua organização de RH e da digitalização do seu HRIS
  • Implement: Como parceiro dos principais editores do mercado, realizamos projetos de implementação técnica e funcional de todas as soluções HRIS (SaaS ou On-Premise)
  • Run: Graças à nossa experiência global em processamento de salários, oferecemos aos nossos clientes vários níveis de externalização de salários.


O que estamos buscando:

Profissional fará parte do time de consultores funcionais do Sistema SuccessFactors módulo Employee Central, e irá atuar na implementação de projetos, melhorias ou suporte.

Deve ter o conhecimento no software em questão, além de um perfil voltado ao pensamento crítico e solução de problemas com grande atenção aos detalhes. Como o suporte ao usuário final e o trabalho em equipe são aspectos importantes do papel, são necessárias excelentes habilidades de comunicação e de pessoas e também deve ter excelentes habilidades de organização.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:

  • Atuar em projetos de implementação do Employee Central e Benefícios, projetos de melhorias e no atendimento de suporte a clientes (AMS);
  • Treinar usuários finais, incluindo profissionais de RH, sobre como usar o SuccessFactors Employee Central e quaisquer funcionalidades relacionadas.
  • Identificar e sugerir melhorias no sistema com base no feedback dos usuários e na evolução das necessidades de negócios.
  • Treinar e capacitar pessoas da equipe no módulo Employee Central;
  • Colaborar com equipes internas e fornecedores para implementar as soluções propostas;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as últimas liberações e produtos da SAP que envolvem o SuccessFactors Employee Central.


O que oferecemos:

  • Um ambiente de trabalho estimulante no seio de uma cultura empreendedora e internacional
  • Uma abordagem transversal das nossas atividades, que favorece o trabalho em equipe e a excelência
  • Numerosas oportunidades de progressão (mobilidade horizontal, vertical e internacional)
  • Múltiplas oportunidades de formação (universidade interna, certificações)
  • Certificado Happy at Work, oferecemos um bom equilíbrio de vida com possibilidades de teletrabalho
  • Um ambiente de trabalho amigável (atividades de equipe trimestrais, seminário internacional anual)

description:

Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and technical expertise to AI-powered, engineering initiatives
  • Advise startups on AI product development using agentic AI, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Develop software in conjunction with startup subject matter experts and engineering teams
  • Stay abreast of AI trends and advise colleagues and clients on emerging AI opportunities
  • Communicate across different stakeholder groups including executive, boards, technical, client and industry

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of software development experience including AI engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Deep experience in AI product development using agents, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

  • Start: ASAP

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic and technical expertise to AI-powered, engineering initiatives
  • Advise startups on AI product development using agentic AI, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Develop software in conjunction with startup subject matter experts and engineering teams
  • Stay abreast of AI trends and advise colleagues and clients on emerging AI opportunities
  • Communicate across different stakeholder groups including executive, boards, technical, client and industry


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of software development experience including AI engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python
  • Deep experience in AI product development using agents, LLMs, and modern AI infrastructure
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista Funcional Salesforce Sênior
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) profissional com experiência em Salesforce e forte visão de processos comerciais para atuar na modelagem, configuração e evolução de soluções dentro da plataforma. Essa pessoa será responsável por conectar as necessidades do negócio com a implementação técnica, garantindo eficiência e aderência funcional nas entregas.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Modelar processos comerciais no Salesforce (B, P, R, A, L)
  • Construir e configurar fluxos, regras de negócio, layouts, perfis de acesso, permissões e automações na plataforma
  • Validar User Stories (US) junto às áreas de negócio, garantindo clareza, entendimento e aderência funcional
  • Atuar como ponte entre as áreas de negócio e tecnologia na definição de soluções
  • Apoiar integrações funcionais com sistemas como SAP e Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), assegurando consistência dos processos ponta a ponta
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review, retrospectiva) e acompanhar entregas com times técnicos e funcionais


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência com configuração e customização no Salesforce
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos comerciais (funil de vendas, gestão de contas, oportunidades, etc.)
  • Experiência com criação de fluxos (Flow), validações e automações
  • Vivência na construção e validação de User Stories
  • Experiência em integração funcional com sistemas corporativos (ex: SAP, OTM ou similares)
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de integração entre Salesforce e SAP
  • Conhecimento em processos logísticos (OTM)
  • Certificações Salesforce (Admin, Sales Cloud, etc.)

title: Italian Data Annotator
description:
We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .


Role Details

  • Work Mode: Remote
  • Engagement Type: Contract 1-3 Months
  • Daily Commitment: 5–6 hours
  • Pay Rate: $4 per hour


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: High School Graduate (or higher) .
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


Next Steps: Evaluation Process

To proceed with your application, please complete the following assessments:

1️⃣ Assessment Test

Assesses your linguistic and analytical skills.


LLM Evaluation Test:


Please note that keeping your camera & location on is mandatory during the assessment. Submissions without camera & location compliance may not be considered.


2️⃣ Versant English Proficiency Test

Evaluates your spoken and written English proficiency.


✅ Once both assessments are successfully completed, you’ll be eligible for onboarding and background verification .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.

title: IAM Support Specialist (L2)
description:
IAM Support Specialist (L2)


Initially for a 3 month contract we are looking for someone to be responsible for handling medium to complex access management requests, providing advanced operational support, and managing escalations. Ensures secure and efficient access aligned with governance and compliance standards while supporting continuous improvement and mentoring L1 agents.


Key Responsibilities

  • Resolve escalated access issues from L1 support
  • Handle complex Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) scenarios
  • Manage access-related incidents and service requests
  • Escalate unresolved or critical issues to L3
  • Maintain accurate ticket documentation and ensure SLA adherence
  • Participate in access reviews, certifications, and audit activities
  • Follow defined workflows, SOPs, and support guidelines
  • Contribute to process improvements and identify automation opportunities
  • Maintain and update documentation and runbooks
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to L1 agents


Core Processes (ITIL-Aligned)

  • Incident Management
  • Problem Management
  • Change Management
  • Continual Service Improvement
  • Knowledge Management

title: .NET Developer
description:
Job Title:

Mid-Level .NET Developer (Backend / Distributed Systems)


Overview

We are seeking a mid-level .NET Developer to join a backend-focused engineering team building and enhancing distributed services in AWS. This role is heavily backend and API-driven, with a strong emphasis on asynchronous processing, system-to-system integration, and resilient service design. The engineer will work on both net-new services and enhancements to existing systems, collaborating closely with product owners and other engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and enhance backend services using .NET and C#

title: AI Art Director (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native art direct who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Lead a team of designers to create visuals that stop scrolls
  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces and Higgsfield
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Tech - Delivery Manager
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência e acompanhamento de profissionais alocados


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime remoto.


Regime de Contratação CLT


Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

* Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos :

* Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian

* Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos

* Formação através da Trilha de Liderança

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an (preferred), GCP, , or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

Role Details

  • Work Mode: Remote
  • Engagement Type: Contract 1-3 Months
  • Daily Commitment: 5–6 hours
  • Pay Rate: $5 per hour


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).

  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.
